name: Psychic
overview: Scripture clearly condemns seeking guidance from psychics, familiar spirits, wizards, and those practicing divination or witchcraft, branding such practices as abominations and defilements (Leviticus 19:31; Deuteronomy 18:9-10). The Lord warns that turning to these occult sources brings severe consequences, including being cut off from the people or even death (Leviticus 20:6, 27). Instead, God calls His people to seek Him alone, emphasizing the futility and danger of consulting the dead or those who claim supernatural insight apart from Him (Isaiah 8:19).
